hero_trending.prob_take: At 6.5%, the market is saying Miller leaves before 2027 roughly once every 15 times, which means bettors have priced in his exit as a genuine black swan event rather than a realistic political outcome. hero_trending.question: Will Howard Lutnick leave the Trump administration before 2027?
hero_trending.prob_take: At 14.5%, the market is pricing Lutnick's departure as a 1-in-7 shot, essentially ruling out any meaningful conflict with Trump before 2027.
